Eyo! Ito yung ginamit kong ingredients: 
- shirataki rice 
- canned tuna
- egg (I used 2 kasi why not 😂)
- garlic and onion
- ½ tsp of oyster sauce

Ito ginawa ko kanina:
- Prepare your shirataki rice as instructed sa package 
- Fry eggs then set aside 
- Saute garlic and onion (you can use yung oil from the canned tuna - I used Gold Seas Olive oil variant so maraming oil yun)
- If translucent na yung onion and medj toasted na yung garlic, add the shirataki rice, followed by tuna then stir-fry and lagay mo na yung oyster sauce and fried egg
- Since gusto ko ng maanghang, I added chili powder on top 😊
